001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Second of three records copying a BLE InitiateBolusRequest; see
009 * {@link InitiateBolusRequestMsg1HistoryLog}. Tandem publishes no name for opcode 293, so this class
010 * name is provisional. Byte 11 was zero in every record observed.
011 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/142.
012 */
013@HistoryLogProps(
014    opCode = 293,
015    displayName = "Initiate Bolus Request 2/3"
016)
017public class InitiateBolusRequestMsg2HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
018
019    private int transactionId;
020    private int bolusId;
021    private long correctionVolume;
022    private long extendedVolume;
023    private int bolusCarbs;
024    private int bolusBG;
025
026    public InitiateBolusRequestMsg2HistoryLog() {}
027
028    public InitiateBolusRequestMsg2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int transactionId, int bolusId, long correctionVolume, long extendedVolume, int bolusCarbs, int bolusBG) {
029        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, transactionId, bolusId, correctionVolume, extendedVolume, bolusCarbs, bolusBG, 0);
030    }
031
032    public InitiateBolusRequestMsg2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int transactionId, int bolusId, long correctionVolume, long extendedVolume, int bolusCarbs, int bolusBG, int headerHighNibble) {
033        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
034        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, transactionId, bolusId, correctionVolume, extendedVolume, bolusCarbs, bolusBG, headerHighNibble);
035        this.transactionId = transactionId;
036        this.bolusId = bolusId;
037        this.correctionVolume = correctionVolume;
038        this.extendedVolume = extendedVolume;
039        this.bolusCarbs = bolusCarbs;
040        this.bolusBG = bolusBG;
041    }
042
043    public int typeId() {
044        return 293;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * <table border="1">
049     * <caption>Parsed fields for InitiateBolusRequestMsg2HistoryLog:</caption>
050     * <tr><td><code>transactionId</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
051     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>correctionVolume</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>extendedVolume</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>bolusCarbs</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>bolusBG</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
056     * </table>
057     */
058    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
059        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
060        this.cargo = raw;
061        parseBase(raw);
062        this.transactionId = raw[10] & 0xFF;
063        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
064        this.correctionVolume = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
065        this.extendedVolume = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
066        this.bolusCarbs = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
067        this.bolusBG = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
068    }
069
070    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int transactionId, int bolusId, long correctionVolume, long extendedVolume, int bolusCarbs, int bolusBG, int headerHighNibble) {
071        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
072            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(293, headerHighNibble),
073            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
074            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
075            new byte[]{ (byte) transactionId, 0 },
076            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
077            Bytes.toUint32(correctionVolume),
078            Bytes.toUint32(extendedVolume),
079            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusCarbs),
080            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusBG)));
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * @return the BLE transaction id of the InitiateBolusRequest; see
085     * {@link InitiateBolusRequestMsg1HistoryLog#getTransactionId()}
086     */
087    public int getTransactionId() {
088        return transactionId;
089    }
090
091    public int getBolusId() {
092        return bolusId;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * @return InitiateBolusRequest.correctionVolume as sent, in milliunits
097     */
098    public long getCorrectionVolume() {
099        return correctionVolume;
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * @return InitiateBolusRequest.extendedVolume as sent, in milliunits
104     */
105    public long getExtendedVolume() {
106        return extendedVolume;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * @return InitiateBolusRequest.bolusCarbs as sent, in grams
111     */
112    public int getBolusCarbs() {
113        return bolusCarbs;
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * @return InitiateBolusRequest.bolusBG as sent, in mg/dL
118     */
119    public int getBolusBG() {
120        return bolusBG;
121    }
122}
